en: Pushing a box up a ramp reduces the required lifting force by increasing the travel distance.
Rubber treads on car tires increase friction with the road to prevent the wheels from slipping.
Earth's larger mass creates a stronger gravitational pull than the Moon, keeping objects firmly grounded.
Running electric current through a coiled wire creates a magnetic field that attracts iron nails.
Closing a switch completes an electrical circuit, allowing current to flow and illuminate a lightbulb.
Light bends when entering water because it slows down, making a partially submerged straw look broken.
Plucking a tight guitar string creates vibrations that push air molecules to transmit sound waves.
Touching a hot metal pan transfers heat directly from the pan to your skin through conduction.
A falling roller coaster gains kinetic energy because its stored potential energy converts into motion.
A movable pulley halves the lifting force required by distributing the load across two rope segments.
The Sun warms Earth through radiation, transferring heat energy via electromagnetic waves across empty space.
Tightening a drum skin increases its vibration frequency, producing a higher-pitched sound when struck with a stick.
